meta.name: offensive-wifi-recon
meta.description: Wi-Fi reconnaissance methodology — adapter selection, monitor mode and packet injection setup, regulatory domain handling, multi-band airspace mapping, hidden SSID discovery, BSSID/ESSID/channel/PMF/encryption fingerprinting, client probe analysis, vendor OUI lookup, war-driving with Kismet/airodump-ng/Wigle, and structured airspace data capture for downstream attacks. Use at the start of any wireless engagement to build the target map before active attacks; covers 2.4 GHz, 5 GHz, and 6 GHz (Wi-Fi 6E) bands and adapter compatibility for each.

copy.tagline: 摸清目标无线网络底细,为后续行动绘制空域地图
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在无线测试前摸清目标网络与安全配置
copy.tagline_en: Map wireless networks and identify hidden SSIDs before an engagement
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to survey target Wi-Fi before an engagement

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按 Wi-Fi 侦察流程带你操作：选网卡、开监听模式、设区域码、扫频段、定位隐藏 SSID、识别加密与客户端、记录目标清单，再进入主动攻击。
howto.when: 当你在无线渗透工程开始时要求先侦察/摸底时触发；原文规定在断网攻击、仿冒热点或抓握手包等主动攻击之前使用。

say.text: 帮我选一个支持 5GHz 和注入的 USB 无线网卡。
say.note: Claude 会按芯片组和频段给出适配器建议。

say.text: 用 airodump-ng 扫描 2.4G 和 5G 全频段，结果存成 CSV。
say.note: Claude 会给出对应命令和输出说明。

say.text: 查一下 AA:BB:CC 这个 OUI 对应哪家厂商。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude guides Wi-Fi recon: adapter selection, monitor mode, regulatory domain, band sweeping, hidden-SSID discovery, encryption/client fingerprinting, and structured target recording before active attacks.
howto.when_en: Triggers at the start of a wireless engagement, before active attacks like deauth, evil-twin, or handshake capture; use it whenever you need to map the airspace first.

say_en.text: Recommend a USB Wi-Fi adapter that supports 5 GHz and packet injection.
say_en.note: Claude suggests adapters by chipset and band.

say_en.text: Scan the 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz bands with airodump-ng and save results to CSV.
say_en.note: Claude provides the exact commands and explains output.

say_en.text: Look up which vendor owns the OUI prefix AA:BB:CC.
say_en.note: Claude ties it to default credentials and known bugs.
